Original inode retained, pre-upgrade bytes preserved but never restored, noinit/recreation. Real user account database untouched; user-record preservation separately covered by software-authenticator tests.

expiry_scope: Historical authorization/credential metadata and a correctly signed request at an explicitly historical test time distinguish expiry scopes. The host checks its actual current clock. These are synthetic expiry fixtures, not elapsed-time or device-expiry measurements.
scope: Optional native reference host with explicit schema3 upgrade and independently authorized reapproval. No SDK source/wire/ABI/dependency changes. No enrollment HTTP/browser connection, installed client, deployed HTTPS, full root/device replacement or expired-unissued credential transition claim.
